delta.comment: ABANDONMENT DECISION (operator, 2026-08-16). 077-F (mcp-launcher-consolidation) is abandoned and will be moved to terminal status `rejected` and archived. REASON: the remaining 077-F scope depended on an `autoharness run` command protocol as the MCP launcher indirection layer; efforts to create that protocol completely failed to allow proper use of the CLI interface, so the feature is no longer a viable option. This is an explicit abandonment, NOT a deferral, NOT a re-block, and NOT an implementation request. STATUS CHOICE: `rejected` is used because backlogit allows `abandoned` only for shipment artifacts; `done`/`accepted` would falsely imply completion. `rejected` routes to .backlogit/archive per registry.yaml. SCOPE DROPPED (not transferred): github server target ratification, pwsh wrapper removal, tavily env-forwarding, exact-version pinning. EXPLICITLY PRESERVED AND NOT ABANDONED: 087-F (bunx-mcp-runtime-consolidation) remains status=done and fully in force - root .mcp.json stays tracked and JS-engine MCP launchers stay on bunx. Tasks 087.001-T/087.002-T/087.003-T are unaffected. Nothing here reverts or supersedes any 087-F decision. History preserved: original description, DoD, goals, and deliberation doc docs/decisions/2026-07-12-mcp-launcher-consolidation-deliberation.md are retained, not deleted.
